pr.title: feat(QPBT/Combining): Preserve finite quadratic POVM obstruction
pr.body:
## Motivation

Issue #511: retain PR #547's closed finite POVM / root-count packet on current
main while leaving the current source-facing constructions and gap context
intact. PR #547 and its branch are untouched by this PR and remain open; this
branch is a fresh replacement built on published main.

## Description

- Preserve the quadratic point witness, the affine / `Option`-completed /
  uniform POVM defect bounds, and the eight-element `21/32` scalar result in a
  new module `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean`
  (eleven unique declarations retained, statements unchanged).
- Reuse merged PR #299's deterministic measurement and effect APIs
  (`deterministicMeasurement`, `deterministicMeasurement_projective` in
  `Test/Completeness/HonestStrategy/MeasurementFamily.lean`, and
  `Measurement.postprocess_comp`) instead of the three generic duplicates the
  saved packet carried. No shared-helper move, no import cycle, and no change
  to `Combining/Apply.lean`, `PointErrorObstruction.lean`, the paper mirrors or
  the blueprint chapters.
- Archive PR #547's original cost and audit record byte-for-byte (116-line,
  6524-byte suffix) under a valid YAML header in
  `audits/2026-09-12_issue511-independent-finite-obstruction.md`.
- Add a limited current-status cross-reference to the existing paper-gap note
  `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`.

Scope is deliberately narrow: these are auxiliary, formalization-only
obstruction results. No full line-law transport, no source theorem, and no
blueprint `\leanok` is claimed; the `21/256` X-axis mixture contribution stays
prose, and the three open `Apply.lean` statements are untouched.

## Testing

- `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean` and
  `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`: pass.
- `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.QuadraticPointObstruction`: passes,
  re-verified after this branch was updated onto current main.
- Fresh axiom probes: all preserved theorems reduce to exactly
  `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, with no `sorryAx`. The module
  contains no `sorry`, `axiom`, `admit`, `native_decide` or unsafe bypass.
- Paper-gap lint, blueprint citation resolution and blueprint Lean sync: pass.
- Installed pre-commit and pre-push gates: pass.

---

Addresses issue #511 without closing it; issue #511 and PR #547 stay open until
this replacement is integrated.

# Review - PR 587 @ 1086ce4c9aa5febc5d5acf026753f03757d2ce4e

Bounded recheck by an independent Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused, and the approved mathematics and prose evidence of review 5243849416 at head 6d79bfcf stands. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 0a2182d59af621ebbd6a36b03c79c77c48566d53. Since that review the branch gained a conflict-free merge of main and one docstring-only commit (1086ce4c, +2/-1 comment lines in MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean); the main-relative change is still the same four files, 475 insertions and 7 deletions against merge base 0a2182d5 on base branch main.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope of this recheck, as directed: the F1 reference fix, the invariance of the rest of the PR's own patch, and exact-head CI. I did not repeat the mathematical or prose review of the preservation packet itself.

F1 is resolved and the new locator is correct. The docstring References block at MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean:18-20 now reads `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`, subsection "The extended-line supplied-point obstruction" (the quadratic material is at lines 255-320). At this head that file contains `\subsection{The extended-line supplied-point obstruction}` at exactly docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex:215, the subsection runs to the next `\section` at :325, and the quadratic argument begins at :255 ("The extended point answer is $\alpha x^2$") and runs through the footnote naming this very module at :313, so both the heading and the line range resolve. The stale string "Unrestricted point witnesses" no longer occurs anywhere in the file. The other three references in the same block (the two `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex` locators and the two blueprint labels) are untouched by this commit.

Nothing else changed. I compared the PR's own main-relative patch at both heads: `git diff $(git merge-base github/main 6d79bfcf) 6d79bfcf` versus `git diff $(git merge-base github/main 1086ce4c) 1086ce4c` differ only in the three lines of that docstring hunk plus the accompanying blob hash and line-count metadata (27530 vs 27563 bytes; added-file length 314 -> 315). The intervening merge commit db1b9b4d brought in only main's five `chore(telemetry): hourly batch` commits 66d359d6..0a2182d5 and resolved without conflict, so no Lean statement, definition, proof, audit or blueprint-facing text moved. The merged-in diff contains no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or `set_option` line. The subject of 1086ce4c is 68 characters, `type(scope): imperative` form, no fix-prefix and no closing reference; the worktree HEAD equals the published head and is clean.

Verification. Exact-head CI via `gh api repos/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/commits/1086ce4c.../status` is `state: success` with all nine contexts success: local-ci/build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, file-length, paper-gaps, proof-debt, proof-evasion, statement-origin and local-ci/summary. I also re-ran `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/QuadraticPointObstruction.lean` in the PR worktree at this head: exit 0, no diagnostics.

Not checked (deliberately, per the bounded scope): the eleven declarations' mathematics, the duplication-against-main survey, the archived audit and the gap-note prose, all of which were checked and approved at 6d79bfcf by review 5243849416 and are byte-identical here; and no full `lake build` (CI's build step is green at this head) and no `#print axioms` re-derivation.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
